opportunities.name: Kayak hotel search with dates, guests and sorting/filters
opportunities.description: On Kayak, search hotels for {destination} from {check_in} to {check_out} for {guest_count} guests, then optionally apply filters and sort the results (e.g. by distance or price low to high).
steps: Click 'Search for hotels'
Type {destination} in the city/hotel/landmark box and pick the matching suggestion
Select {check_in} and {check_out} in the date picker
Open rooms & guests and click Increment until the guest count is {guest_count}
Click Search/Update
Optionally apply {filters} (stars, amenities, style, free internet)
Sort results by {sort_order} (Distance / Price low to high)

instances.values: Le Marais, Paris; 27–2; +2 guests; sorted by Distance, then Price low→high
Los Angeles (City); 21–23; 7 guests; 8+ rating, 3–4 stars, free internet, Family style, air-conditioned; sorted by Distance, then Price low→high

opportunities.name: Qatar Airways flight search and fare selection
opportunities.description: On Qatar Airways, search flights from {origin} to {destination} departing {depart_date}, set the passengers/class ({passengers}, {cabin_class}), show flights and select a fare.
steps: Type {origin} in the From field and pick the suggestion
Type {destination} in the To field and pick the suggestion (or use the destination preselected from Explore)
Open the Depart date picker and choose {depart_date}
Click Continue / close the calendar
Open 'Passengers / Class' and adjust adult/child/infant counts and {cabin_class}
Click Confirm, then 'Show flights'
Click the chosen fare and press 'Select fare'

instances.values: Colombo → New York, 24 June 2023, +1 child, Business/First; selected LKR fares
Doha → Durban (from Explore > Africa), 28 May 2023, +1 infant; selected QAR 4,980 fare

opportunities.name: Qatar Airways hotel booking search
opportunities.description: In the Qatar Airways Hotels section, search hotels in {destination} from {check_in} to {check_out}, adjust guests/rooms, sort or filter the results and open a property's availability.
steps: Click 'Book', then 'Hotels'
Type {destination} and pick the suggestion
Pick {check_in} and {check_out} in the calendar
Click Search
Optionally adjust the guests/rooms ({guests}) and click Done
Sort by {sort_order} or apply filters
Open a hotel's 'See availability' and Reserve

instances.values: Las Vegas, 10–16 April 2023, sorted by Price (lowest first)
Washington DC, 25 May–5 June 2023, guests adjusted, filters applied, See availability → Reserve
